short_description: Driverama is a pan-European online used-car platform launched in April 2021 by AURES Holdings — the Prague-based used-car group behind AAA Auto and Mototechna, controlled by private-equity firm Abris Capital Partners and founded by Anthony Denny. Note: Driverama is a subsidiary of AURES Holdings, not of AUTO1 Group. The company launched retail buying in Germany in July 2021, expanded to the Netherlands in January 2022 and to Berlin retail micro-branches in 2022. Reporting on any 2022 wind-down could not be independently verified at profile build; AURES Holdings continued to disclose Driverama within its brand portfolio in 2023 and 2024 sales reports.
